project: Sprint 21-D: Trade Journal Attribution + Pipeline Confidence Monitor
description: Add regime labels and pipeline attribution to every closed trade. Track which pipeline stage drove each decision. Add pipeline confidence monitoring endpoint to detect future all-HOLD regressions early.

userStories.title: Add regime_tier and deciding_stage columns to trade_journal
userStories.description: As a trader, I want every closed trade tagged with the regime tier and the pipeline stage that drove the decision so that I can tune the strategy based on what's actually working.
acceptanceCriteria: trade_journal table has 'regime_tier' INTEGER column (migration_011 or new)
trade_journal table has 'deciding_stage' TEXT column (e.g. 'technical', 'debate', 'news')
trade_journal table has 'bull_score' REAL and 'bear_score' REAL columns
trade_journal table has 'debate_confidence' REAL column
Approval router saves these from pipeline result metadata
GET /trades/journal includes all attribution fields
ruff check engine/routers/ passes
pytest tests/ -k 'not integration' passes
userStories.notes: Without attribution we're flying blind on strategy tuning. The pipeline result dict already contains bull_score, bear_score, regime from Stage 2/3 — just need to persist them.

userStories.title: Add pipeline confidence monitoring endpoint
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a GET /pipeline/confidence-stats endpoint so that I can detect all-HOLD regressions (like the MAX_TOKENS bug) before they waste a full trading day.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /pipeline/confidence-stats returns last 24h pipeline run stats
Response includes: total_runs, hold_count, trade_count, avg_confidence, min_confidence, max_confidence
Response includes: hold_rate (hold_count/total_runs as float 0-1)
If hold_rate > 0.90 and total_runs >= 5, response flags 'alert': 'HIGH_HOLD_RATE'
Reads from pipeline_runs table in engine/data/jarvis_trader.db
Endpoint registered in existing analytics_router.py or new router
ruff check passes
pytest tests/ -k 'not integration' passes
userStories.notes: The MAX_TOKENS bug caused 115 HOLDs in 24h with avg confidence 3-6%. This endpoint would have caught it within the first hour. Critical operational monitoring.

userStories.title: Dashboard: Trade Attribution Widget on /trades/journal page
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a table on the journal page showing regime tier, deciding stage, and bull/bear scores for each trade so that I can visually spot patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: dashboard/app/trades/journal/page.tsx exists (create if not present)
Page shows table with columns: Date, Symbol, Side, P&L, Regime Tier, Deciding Stage, Bull Score, Bear Score, Debate Confidence
Data fetched via fetchEngine('/trades/journal')
Uses existing Badge component with bull/bear/warn/neutral variants
pnpm run build passes (zero TypeScript errors)
No hardcoded localhost:8010
userStories.notes: Use existing dashboard conventions: SWR for data fetching, Tailwind only, Badge variants are strict: 'bull' | 'bear' | 'warn' | 'info' | 'neutral'.
